name: Classic Diamond Kite
description: A traditional ripstop diamond with a bowed ribbon tail. Flies steady in 8–18 mph winds and packs down to the length of a pencil case.

name: Swift Dual-Line Stunt Kite
description: A responsive 5-foot sport kite for loops, dives and figure eights. Comes with two 80-foot lines and padded wrist straps.

name: Sea Turtle Kite
description: A friendly turtle with a wide body that launches easily from a standing start. Ready to fly on a handle with 100 feet of line.

name: Braided Kite Line, 500 ft
description: 50-lb test braided polyester line on a sturdy cardboard winder. The right strength for most single-line kites.

name: Spinning Windsock
description: A 4-foot spiral windsock with streamer tails. Fly it below your kite or hang it from the porch to read the wind at a glance.

name: Featherlight Delta Kite
description: A 6-foot delta that lifts off in breezes as light as 4 mph. Our pick for calm summer evenings on the beach.

name: Breaker Quad-Line Kite
description: Four lines let you hover, fly in reverse and park the kite mid-air. For flyers ready to move past dual-line.

name: Rainbow Sled Kite
description: Two light rods and nothing to assemble. Unfold it, clip on the line and run.

name: Hoop Winder Reel
description: A wide hoop reel that winds line in fast and keeps it from tangling. Holds up to 800 feet.

name: Ripstop Repair Kit
description: Self-adhesive ripstop patches, spare connectors and end caps in a zip pouch. Fixes most tears in minutes, right on the sand.

name: Cellular Box Kite
description: A two-cell box kite with fiberglass spars. Climbs straight up and holds its spot in gusty wind.

name: Ridge Parafoil
description: A frameless dual-line foil that fills with air and pulls hard. With no spars to snap, it shrugs off crashes on the beach.

name: Jellyfish Kite
description: A smiling jellyfish with eight streaming tentacles that dance in the wind. Folds small enough for a beach bag.

name: Pro Stunt Line Set
description: A color-coded pair of 90-foot low-stretch lines with wrist straps. Gives dual-line kites sharp, precise turns.

name: Spiral Sand Anchor
description: A twist-in sand stake with a swivel clip. Park your kite in the sky while you stop for lunch.
